name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

summary.oneLiner: A free LPG gas connection for women from poor households.
summary.whatIsIt: PM Ujjwala Yojana gives free LPG gas connections to women so they don't have to cook with firewood or coal. You must be a woman, at least 18 years old, and not already have an LPG connection. Your household should also be identified as poor, for example through a ration card or SC/ST status.

benefits.text: Free LPG gas connection with first refill and stove support

whoCanApply: You are a woman aged 18 or above
You do not already have an LPG connection
Your household is identified as poor (ration card, SC/ST status, or similar)

documents.name: Ration card or BPL proof
documents.why: Used to confirm your household is eligible

howToApply.title: Visit a nearby LPG distributor
howToApply.detail: Go to any Indane, Bharat Gas or HP Gas distributor near you.

howToApply.title: Fill the Ujjwala form
howToApply.detail: Submit the form with your Aadhaar and household proof.

howToApply.title: Get your connection
howToApply.detail: Once approved, you receive a free connection, first cylinder and stove support.

rules.label: You are a woman aged 18 or above
rules.sourceQuote: The scheme is applicable for adult women belonging to poor households.

rules.label: You are a woman aged 18 or above
rules.sourceQuote: The applicant should be an adult woman, 18 years of age or above.

rules.label: You do not already have an LPG connection
rules.sourceQuote: The applicant's household should not already own an LPG connection.

rules.label: Your household is identified as poor (ration card, SC/ST status, or similar)
rules.sourceQuote: Households covered under the Socio Economic Caste Census (SECC), or holding Antyodaya/priority ration cards, are eligible.

rules.label: Your household is identified as poor (ration card, SC/ST status, or similar)
rules.sourceQuote: Women belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) households are eligible under the scheme.

customQuestion.en: Can you give a self-declaration that your household is poor (BPL-equivalent)?
customQuestion.hi: क्या आप स्व-घोषणा दे सकते हैं कि आपका परिवार गरीब (बीपीएल के समान) है?
customQuestion.te: మీ కుటుంబం పేదది (బీపీఎల్‌కు సమానం) అని మీరు స్వీయ ప్రకటన ఇవ్వగలరా?
customQuestion.ta: உங்கள் குடும்பம் ஏழ்மையானது (பிபிஎல் சமமானது) என்று நீங்கள் சுய அறிவிப்பு அளிக்க முடியுமா?

rules.label: Your household is identified as poor (ration card, SC/ST status, or similar)
rules.sourceQuote: Eligible households can also be identified through a self-declaration where SECC data is unavailable.

The local shop or agency that supplies gas cylinders in your area.
